hooks.text: 半自动战斗中手动调整站位，并把握英雄终极技能的释放时机
hooks.excerpt: Dive into a strategic, tactical semi-auto battler with player agency through positioning and powerful activated ultimate abilities. Each hero comes with their own unique ability. Use it at the right time to turn the tide of battle, waste it, and risk a soul-crushing defeat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把看似不相容的英雄凑成队伍，用队友关系激活强力组合
hooks.excerpt: Seer's Gambit is all about discovering the best group composition. Every character in the game can shine when combined with the right co-heroes. Unlock powerful combos by picking the perfect adventurers for your party and demolish your enemies with the power of teamwork.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 征服并升级世界区域，解锁新英雄和团队增益，同时让世界随进度变化
hooks.excerpt: Explore and upgrade the captivating, yet dangerous world of Emalon to unlock new heroes or powerful group buffs for meta progression. Earn resources during your adventures and predict the right upgrades to invest in for your heroes to stand a chance against the lurking evil. As you explore, progress and shape your future, the world will change around you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
